source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-36

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic fluid level check

specs.what: fluid to raise level from ADD to FULL

notes: The cold setting of 1/4" below ADD leaves room for the fluid to expand as it reaches 180°F.
The level indicator (dipstick) is in the filler pipe at the right rear corner of the engine. At normal operating temperature the level should be at FULL.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic shift linkage adjustment (Corvette)
steps: For the Corvette, use the console linkage adjustment in figure 4T in the manual (next page); the column and other console steps on this page are for other car lines.
